title: Inconsistent KeyboardInterrupt handling
detail: The code has inconsistent handling of KeyboardInterrupt exceptions. When standalone_mode is True, it raises Abort() but when False, it raises Abort() from e. This inconsistency can cause different behaviors and potentially mask the original exception in some cases.

title: Inverted logic in accept_html
detail: The logic was inverted. Previously, 'text/html' being accepted would return True, but now the condition checks if 'text/html' is NOT in self, which means it will return True when text/html is not accepted. This breaks the intended behavior of the property.
note: accept_html now returns true when text/html is not accepted
